item.title: Low-carbon technologies support energy security by buffering energy price shocks
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04131-5

Energy supply crises matter because their economic impacts extend beyond energy markets. This Comment argues that energy security should be understood by how energy systems transmit price shocks to the wider economy. Low-carbon technologies matter because, unlike fossil fuels, they dampen this transmission through the economy.
